## Hypothesis

Adjusting exit parameters for different setup qualities (super, level, trendline) and runner target aims to capture more profit on the 5/04 winner day without increasing losses on loser days. The hypothesis is that widening super stop/TP1, tuning level quantities/stops, and setting a runner target of 3.0x will improve edge capture on strong bearish rejection days.

## Mechanism

Entry logic remains unchanged; exit logic uses parameters: super_stop=-0.15 (15% SL), super_tp1=0.75 (75% TP1), runner_target=3.0 (runner profit target as multiple of entry premium), level_qty=18 (level setup quantity), level_stop=-0.12 (12% SL), level_tp1=0.3 (30% TP1), trendline_stop=-0.06 (6% SL). These parameters define stop losses and take profits for qualifying entries based on setup quality tier.
